title: Resting-State EEG in Parkinson's Disease and Healthy Controls
description: This dataset comprises 358 resting-state EEG recordings from 312 participants with Parkinson's disease and healthy controls, collected under eyes-open resting conditions. It includes longitudinal sessions for some participants along with demographic, clinical (MoCA, UPDRS-III, levodopa dose), and acquisition metadata. The data are organized in BIDS format to support research on EEG biomarkers of Parkinson's disease progression and neurophysiology.
methods_description: EEG recordings were acquired in BrainVision format (.vhdr, .vmrk, .eeg) using Pz as reference, with 63-64 EEG channels and some auxiliary channels (e.g., audio, respiratory). Most recordings were sampled at 500 Hz, with a subset at 25,000 Hz. Recordings were collected during eyes-open resting-state conditions and organized according to BIDS 1.11.1.
